content.text: TodayTourist honors his co-operation with the BNH FC FC FC(FC) Vietnam Corporation) on a three-day, two-night train tour from 18–20/07/2026 with an 880 car scale.
Not only is it a vacation trip, this is a journey for the FC Vietnam group to share, mount and retain beautiful memories through the special activity series:
Visiting the Church of Song Wing with peaceful, solemn spaces.
Fired himself in the intense football program.
Discovering the Tam Wins Tower – The work bears the historic mark of the sea city.
Subjugate the image of Christ the King, watching the entire China scene from above.
Repeated by the night Gala Dinner is emotional with laughter, exciting events, and unforgettable bond moments.
My sincere thanks to the Joint Head/Messalm Vietnam Corporation for giving their trust to TodayTourist. May the Company grow stronger, reap more success and see again on the next journeys!
